publication.author: Xinyi Yuan
publication.title: Explicit Kodaira-Spencer Maps over Shimura Curves

translation.attestation_locator: Automorphic forms, Shimura varieties and L-functions section; first entry
translation.qualification: The author calls the PDF a translation of the published Chinese article; the page also generally warns that linked files may differ slightly from published versions. No independent Chinese-English comparison is claimed.

applications.locator: Theorem 1.1, English translation p3; proof Section 3 pp10-17
applications.hypotheses: Indefinite quaternion algebra over Q, maximal order, open level U, determinant condition, compatible principal polarization, base Z[1/n(U)]
applications.result: The square-Hodge determinant Kodaira-Spencer injection has image d_B times the square relative dualizing bundle.
applications.specialization: d_B=210. Do not invert 210 in the integral statement or replace the image by a square-root multiplier.

applications.locator: Definitions pp2-3, Theorem1.1 p3, Sections4.2-4.3 pp20-26
applications.result: Isometry with Hodge squared norm (2pi)^(-2) times the absolute integral and Petersson norm 2 Im(tau).
applications.deduction: Original Faltings normalization gives h_Y=h_F+log(pi) for dimension2; hence h_omega^2=2h_F+2log(pi)+log(210).

applications.result: Regular semistable moduli stack over Z[1/n(U)], smooth outside d_B and proper when B is division.
applications.restriction: Fine level U(3) is used over Z[1/3]. The printed 'contains U(N)' phrase is not used to infer fineness for larger levels.

applications.locator: Coarse orbifold divisor p7; Lemma2.1 pp8-10; metric sentence p10
applications.result: The coarse Q-line bundle with horizontal coefficients1-1/e_P pulls back to the stack dualizing bundle and compatibly to normal finer scheme levels; these maps preserve Petersson metrics.
applications.restriction: Retain normality, integral base and ramification indices. The independent D210 normalizer quotient calculation is not replaced by this lemma.

comparison.result: Mathematical contents agree; extraction differences are recorded explicitly. This is not a comparison with the Chinese journal PDF.
